receiver.latencyMeaning: Assumed post-threshold latency; TI delay is measured at vd=0 and is not an exact Schmitt-trip latency.
receiver.dynamicStatus: Uncharacterized physical narrow-pulse, overdrive, common-mode slew and clamp behavior

network.groundDefinition: IC ground, pin shunts and bias returns are the quiet reference 0 V; the encoder driver reference is the dynamic shared-return node g. No receiver ground displacement is silently added.
network.clamps: Absent; currents beyond domain are diagnostic linear-network values only.
network.cable: Lumped capacitances only; no propagation, distributed loss or measured cable model.

numerics.method: Exact affine-segment modal propagation; continuous linear-interpolation error bounds M2*h^2/8; adaptive root isolation and coarse/fine verification.

scope: Conditional numerical characterization only; no physical receiver validation or control scoring.
